description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides several HTTP GET endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for notesbackend, such as welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome string message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds a redirect to the Swagger UI page, preserving the original request's scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a string 'OK' indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information string about notesbackend.
